transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

My wife wanted me to come in. I keep hearing water running and men whispering inside the walls when nobody’s there. And sometimes I see this dark, wet patch spreading across the hallway, but when I check it, the floor is dry. It’s... it scared her.
Have you used any drugs or alcohol recently?
I’m not sure what you mean by recently. I haven’t noticed anything like that making a difference.
Did the voices and the dark patch start while you were using drugs or alcohol, or soon after?
No, I don’t think so. It’s been the water running, the whispering in the walls, and that wet-looking patch in the hallway—even though the floor is dry when I go look.
How long have you been hearing the whispering and seeing the wet patch?
About seven months now. It started around the winter freeze, when the house repairs became this mess I couldn’t get out from under.
Do you believe someone is causing the whispering or the wet patch on purpose?

I know it sounds far-fetched, but yes. I’m certain the mold and the wiring in that house have poisoned everything I own. And I can tell the neighbors are watching, waiting to see when I mess up again.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or neurological illness?
No, not that I know of. I’ve never been told I have a brain or neurological illness.
Have you found yourself caring much less than usual about things like seeing people, work, or hobbies?
Yeah. I used to show up for soccer, brew beer in the garage, help out at the fire department. Now it all just feels pointless. I can’t make myself care enough to go.
Have people told you that your speech has become hard to follow or doesn't make sense?
I’m not sure. Nobody’s told me that directly. I know I can get quiet and have trouble finding the right words sometimes, but I don’t think I’ve been making no sense.
Do you ever feel that an outside force is controlling your thoughts or actions?

I don’t know about controlling my thoughts exactly, but I’m certain the mold and wiring in that house have poisoned everything I own. And the neighbors… I can tell they’re watching, waiting to see when I mess up again.
Have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Yeah. Most days I wake up already feeling like I’ve failed as a husband and a man. That heavy feeling just stays with me all day, until I go to bed.
Did the whispering and the wet patch start before you began feeling depressed?
No. I’d already been feeling depressed for a while, like I’d stopped caring about my normal life and felt like a failure every day. The whispering and the wet patches started after that.
Do the whispering and the things you see seem to be telling you that you are a failure or deserve to be punished?

They don’t exactly say I’m a failure. I hear water running and men whispering inside the walls when nobody’s there. And sometimes I see this dark wet patch spreading down the hallway, even though I’ve checked and it’s dry.
Have you ever felt that thoughts were being put into your mind by someone or something outside of you?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t felt like someone was putting thoughts into my head.
Have you had a head injury before any of this started?
I’m not sure. I don’t remember having any kind of head injury before this started.
Have you ever had a seizure?
No, not that I know of. I don’t remember ever having a seizure.
Before any of this started, were you ever told you had mold poisoning or any other medical illness caused by the house?

I wasn’t told by a doctor, but I’m certain the mold and the wiring in that house poisoned everything I own. I know it sounds far-fetched, but it’s real. The neighbors are watching too, waiting to see when I mess up again.
Before these experiences began, were you diagnosed with any medical illness?
No, I don’t think I had any medical diagnosis before all this began.
Have the whispering and the wet patch ever happened during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

No. They started after I was already feeling really low—like I’d stopped caring about my normal life and felt like a failure every day. Before that, I never had the whispering or saw those wet patches.
When the whispering or the wet patch happens, are you always feeling depressed at that same time?
Yes. They only started after I was already depressed, when I’d stopped caring about my normal life and felt like a failure every day. I never had any of that before then.
